description_en: Queries the number of risk items detected in the configuration assessment of one or more cloud services by using the instance IDs of the cloud services
description_zh: 根据云产品实例ID查看单个或多个云产品中云平台配置检查风险项的个数
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-risk-list-check-result --source-ip 59.57.XX.XX --lang zh --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids rm-bp1e8t4q15sr30000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRiskListCheckResult
